# lago_add_on (Resource)

Manages a Lago add-on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lago = {
      source  = "registry.opentofu.org/rpcpool/lago"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lago" {
  api_endpoint = var.lago_api_endpoint
  api_key      = var.lago_api_key
}

resource "lago_tax" "vat" {
  name = "VAT"
  code = "vat_20"
  rate = 20.0
}

resource "lago_add_on" "setup_fee" {
  name            = "Setup Fee"
  code            = "setup_fee"
  description     = "One-time setup fee charged at onboarding"
  amount_cents    = 10000
  amount_currency = "USD"

  invoice_display_name = "Onboarding Setup Fee"

  tax_codes = [lago_tax.vat.code]
}

variable "lago_api_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "lago_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `amount_cents` (Number) Add-on amount in cents.
- `amount_currency` (String) Currency code for the add-on amount (e.g. `USD`).
- `code` (String) Unique add-on code. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Add-on name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Add-on description.
- `invoice_display_name` (String) Display name shown on invoices.
- `tax_codes` (Set of String) List of tax codes to apply to the add-on.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Add-on creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, set to the add-on code.
- `lago_id` (String) Lago internal UUID for the add-on.
